_comment: Single source of truth for the Summaverick brand. The logo is the founder-supplied metallic render (summaverick-group-logo.jpg); every other image is derived from it by cropping/resizing — the artwork is never redrawn. Edit values here, then run `pnpm brand`. See BRAND.md.
name: Summaverick
tagline: Personal assistants and enterprise agents, built for mobile, web, and business platforms.

source._note: masterImage is the full lock-up (S + wordmark). markCrop is the square, in master-image pixels, that isolates just the metallic S for the icon and the header/footer marks. Re-measure only if you replace the master render.

marks._note: Rendered pixel size of the header/footer badge. Height matches width (square).
